card.name: Inside trial codes and hormone phrases
card.fires_on: Partway through trial identifiers such as ALFA-0701 or VEG110727, where the hyphen or a letter comes before the rest of the code. Also on linking words inside hormone phrases like 'conversion of cortisone'.

modes.label: Trial codes
modes.description: The hyphen or letter in the middle of a study code name, before the number finishes.
modes.example: In the randomized STS trial (VE<<G>>110727), myocard

modes.label: Hormone phrases
modes.description: A small linking word or hyphen inside steroid or hormone-binding wording.
modes.example: enzyme 11β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 1 (11βHSD-1) is required for conversion<< of>> cortisone to its active metabolite

card.plain: It fires in the middle of study code names and in some hormone phrases, as the text continues to the next part.
